quote: He sat on one of the low rubble walls when she found him: thin, shoulders bowed as if the weight of everything had sat on them...
Among those few things he had gathered a cloth lay folded like a soft accusation...

value: refuses to give name; appears half-possessed/listening to a private voice
quote: He would not give a name... there was a look in his eyes then—vacant, yes, but also like someone listening to a voice only he could half-hear.

value: flinched at photo; reached instinctively; suppressed vocal reaction; remains unnamed
quote: He kept to the tarpaulins' shade and did not barge into bargaining; he watched tokens move in other people's hands ... The young refugee flinched as if struck. He stepped forward before he could think better of it, fingers reaching for the photograph though his jaw worked as if to keep a word from escaping.
The young refugee waited against the far wall, hands clenched, shoulders moving with small, anxious breaths.

value: reveals fragmented sensory memory (smell: rice and smoke); traces photograph with trembling finger; cannot name actors
quote: "I remember a smell," he said at last, voice small. "Rice, and… smoke. And someone—someone called—" He broke off as if the mouth had been struck. His fingers found the photograph in Mercy's palm without asking and traced the faded face with a trembling fingertip.

value: agree to meet at ruined stairwell at first light with Mercy and two witnesses
quote: They agreed to meet at the ruined stairwell at first light, two witnesses and Mercy and the refugee, to look for traces the refugee's gesture had suggested.
